body: The OrderProcessor class is a classic example of a 'God Object' or a violation of the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). It is currently handling validation, pricing, persistence, and notifications. Each of these should be moved to a specialized service.

comments.body: This class is taking on too many responsibilities. The validation of the order should be encapsulated in its own validator class or within the Order domain object itself.
Pricing and tax calculation logic is business-critical and likely to change. Moving this to a PricingService or TaxCalculator would improve maintainability.
The OrderProcessor should not know how to save an order to a database. This is a clear violation of SRP. Introduce an OrderRepository to handle persistence.
Sending emails is an infrastructure concern. This should be delegated to a NotificationService to keep the business logic clean.
